items.title: Engineering VDD — Revenue Recognition
items.description: Identified a $750K EBITDA normalization adjustment driven by a revenue recognition issue, directly impacting purchase price considerations.

items.title: SaaS Buy-Side Diligence
items.description: Flagged customer concentration with the top 3 customers representing ~52% of ARR, prompting further diligence into customer retention and contract continuity.

items.title: Software Carve-Outs
items.description: Executed two carve-out engagements (~$20M and ~$6M in standalone revenue) for a buy-side software acquirer, isolating target businesses through revenue/cost mapping and shared-cost allocations.

items.title: Multinational Asset Consolidation
items.description: Designed audit procedures for a ~$32M asset consolidation across 4 subsidiaries in 3 countries, testing intercompany eliminations and foreign-currency translation.
